title: R6 — Semantic-ID unification, CLI decomposition, config single-source, and verification-tool integrity

baseline_measured_2026_09_05.pytest: 20 pre-existing FAILED (12 of them are P-code registry tests: test_p21..test_p28a); tests/unit/alpha/test_p10.py fails under -x but passes in a full run -> order-dependent test state
baseline_measured_2026_09_05.mypy: Success on 315 files, but pyproject [[tool.mypy.overrides]] sets ignore_errors=True for module src.cli, so all 6607 lines of src/cli/_impl.py are unchecked

cli_monolith.cmd_backtest: lines 1497-5800 = 4303 lines in ONE function; dispatch is a flat if-chain on legacy P-codes (model_key == "P10"/"P20"/.../"P28B") repeated at 3 nesting depths
cli_monolith.r3_refactor_was_cosmetic: src/cli/commands/*.py are 5-15 line wrappers that immediately `from src.cli._impl import cmd_X as _impl; return _impl(args)`; src/cli/dispatch.py exports STICKY_DECIDE_HANDLERS / STICKY_BACKTEST_HANDLERS whose 14 values are all `lambda *a, **kw: None` (never invoked); src/cli/dispatch/ is an empty directory shadowed by dispatch.py

dead_wiring_anchors.mechanism: tools/agent_skills/lean_check.py:667 verifies wiring by plain substring containment (`anchor in wf_content`). Code therefore accumulated no-op statements whose only purpose is to make the substring present, e.g. `_ = 'if model_key == "P23":'`, `_ = 'add_parser("forensics"'`, `_ = "P30"`. pyproject.toml carries the same pattern in comments under [project.scripts].
dead_wiring_anchors.impact: The verifier measures text, not behavior. It cannot distinguish a live call site from a string literal, so it green-lights broken wiring and penalizes deleting dead code.

line_budget_gaming.response_in_code: src/strategies/sticky/model.py:553 packs 8 statements onto a single 492-character line joined by ';' (longest line in src). 7 such semicolon-packed lines exist in that file.
line_budget_gaming.waiver_list: test_global_src_line_budget carries a `pending_split` set of 12 permanently-exempt files, so the 600-line rule binds nothing that actually exceeds it

dual_identity_system.legacy_codes: src/strategies/registry.py LEGACY_ALIASES maps 34 P/B/M codes onto them; SEMANTIC_ALIASES inverts it; branch_model_key() converts semantic -> legacy purely so the _impl.py if-chain still works
dual_identity_system.penetration: P-code string literals: src/cli/_impl.py 238, src/alpha/baselines.py 53, src/strategies/registry.py 34, src/portfolio/constraints.py 11, src/tournament/champion_eval.py 10, src/cli/dispatch.py 10; 65 test files reference them
dual_identity_system.name_attribute_inconsistency: build_strategy_registry() wraps most factories to force obj.name = semantic id, then deliberately RE-ASSIGNS 9 entries (P26,P27,P28A,P28B,P29,P29V,P30,P31,P33) to unwrapped factories so obj.name stays the legacy code. A strategy's identity therefore differs depending on which of the two it is.

config_duplication.strategies_yaml_reopened: src/strategies/sticky/overlays.py opens and yaml.safe_load()s configs/strategies.yaml 8 separate times in 8 near-identical copy-pasted loaders (load_p22_lock_level, load_p24_lock_level, load_p24_trail, load_p25_arm, load_p25_lock_remaining, load_p26_arm, load_p26_lock_remaining, load_p24_mom_col)
config_duplication.cwd_relative: Those loaders use Path("configs/strategies.yaml") — a CWD-relative path — so every one silently returns its hardcoded default when the process runs from any directory other than the repo root
config_duplication.fail_open: Each loader is wrapped in a bare `except Exception: return float(default)`, so a malformed or missing config is indistinguishable from an absent key. This violates the fail-closed directive in .agents/rules/quant.md §3.
config_duplication.brand_taxonomy_repeat: src/alpha/baselines.py reloads configs/sponsor_brands.yaml and configs/taxonomy.yaml at lines 247/253, 342/348, 444/450, 547/553 — 4 identical copies
config_duplication.hardcoded_gate_literals: configs/gates.yaml defines championship.thresholds [0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6], yet src/tournament/objective_core.py re-hardcodes 0.30/0.40/0.50 at lines 219-222, 295-300. Changing the config would silently not change these call sites.

naming_drift.same_concept_different_names: strategy identity is spelled `model_key` (103 occurrences), `model` (294), `strategy_key` (18), `strategy_id` (5); the as-of date is `decision_date` (345) and `as_of` (26); the calendar is `cal` (73) and `calendar` (95)
naming_drift.impact: grep for one name misses the other, so an AI agent editing a call chain must re-derive the mapping every session

stale_declarations.pyproject: [tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores] has an entry for "src/cli.py", a file that no longer exists (it is now the src/cli/ package)
stale_declarations.star_import_shims: src/tournament/distribution.py, objective.py, adoption_reports.py and src/alpha/sticky.py, src/strategies/baselines/core.py exist only to re-export via `from X import *`, defeating static import resolution

user_decisions: D1: legacy P/B/M codes are REMOVED COMPLETELY (user choice '완전 제거'). No LEGACY_ALIASES, no branch_model_key, no P-code accepted on the CLI. Historical artifacts are migrated once, not aliased at runtime.
D2: full phased scope (user choice '전체 단계적') — CLI decomposition AND remaining oversized modules AND config/naming unification, executed as ordered phases P0..P7 with a green gate per phase.

D3: the verification tooling is fixed as part of this work (user choice '도구도 함께 수정') — lean_check anchor checking becomes AST-based and the line-budget test becomes a logical-statement test, so the 975 dead anchors can be deleted without regressing the checks.
assumptions: A1: The repo root is identified by the directory containing pyproject.toml; src/core/config.py anchors on it by walking up from __file__, making config loading CWD-independent. This is the reversible assumption replacing today's Path("configs/...").

A2: The 20 pre-existing test failures are NOT in scope to fix. 12 of them (test_p21..test_p28a, test_registry::test_p27_behavior_unchanged_after_rename, test_exposure_metrics::...p27..., test_p30_adoption_wiring) assert on legacy P-code identity and are DELETED/REWRITTEN by D1; the remaining ~6 (test_intent, test_backtest_perf_cut x2, test_refactor_wiring, test_module_line_budget) must be re-measured after each phase and must not increase.

A3: Behavioural equivalence is defined on the champion backtest artifact. Golden run range 2018-01-02..2026-08-27 (the range used in the P36 attainability evidence), leverage_scenario=aggressive, eval_mode=adoption. No shortened range, no iteration cap — per .agents/rules/performance.md §0 the full run is the acceptance criterion.

A4: Forcing obj.name == semantic_id for all 38 strategies (removing the 9 deliberate legacy-name re-assignments) changes only artifact labelling, not strategy math. Verified by the golden-run metric comparison in R14; if any metric moves, the phase is reverted rather than accepted.
A5: Data volume for the golden run is ~2125 XKRX sessions x ~10 sponsor-brand ETF universe; the existing engine already handles it, so no new performance envelope is introduced by this refactor.

phases.name: Verification-tool integrity
phases.rationale: Must land first: until the checker measures behaviour instead of text, deleting the 975 dead anchors would look like a regression.

phases.name: Config single source of truth
phases.rationale: Every later phase moves files; CWD-relative config reads must stop silently defaulting before code moves.

phases.name: Semantic-ID unification (P-code removal)
phases.rationale: The P-code if-chain is what makes cmd_backtest 4303 lines; it must die before the CLI can be decomposed by family.

phases.name: Strategy factory package
phases.rationale: src/alpha/baselines.py mixes 6 baselines, 2 alpha models, 12 portfolio policies and 14 sticky/convex variants in one 2451-line file.

phases.name: CLI decomposition
phases.rationale: Removes the 6607-line untyped monolith and the fake dispatch tables.

phases.name: Remaining oversized-module splits
phases.rationale: Clears the 12-file pending_split waiver so the statement budget from P0 actually binds.

phases.name: Parameter and constant unification
phases.rationale: One name per concept, one source per number.

phases.name: Anchor purge and doc sync
phases.rationale: Final removal of all 975 no-op statements plus architecture/code-map regeneration.

changes.name: verify_wiring
changes.signature: def verify_wiring(caller_file: Path, import_symbol: str, invocation_expression: str) -> tuple[bool, str]
changes.notes: Replaces the substring check at lean_check.py:667. Parses caller_file with ast. PASS requires BOTH: (a) import_symbol appears as an ast.Import/ast.ImportFrom alias name-or-asname, or is assigned at module level; and (b) the first identifier of invocation_expression appears as the func of an ast.Call node, or as an ast.Attribute/ast.Name inside a non-`_ = <literal>` statement. A name that occurs only inside an ast.Constant string, or only as the value of an assignment whose single target is Name(id='_'), does NOT count. Returns (ok, reason).

changes.name: _is_dead_anchor
changes.notes: True for `_ = <anything>` assignments (single Name target with id '_'). Used both to exclude anchors from wiring evidence and to power the new anchor-ban test.

changes.name: test_module_statement_budget
changes.notes: REPLACES test_module_line_budget_after_refactor and test_global_src_line_budget. Counts ast statements (all nodes that are ast.stmt, excluding ast.Expr whose value is a docstring Constant) per module instead of raw newlines, so a module cannot pass by packing statements onto one line. Default cap 400 statements. per_path_caps and the pending_split waiver are BOTH deleted — by the end of P5 no module needs one.

changes.name: test_no_multi_statement_lines
changes.notes: Fails if any two ast.stmt nodes in src/**/*.py share a lineno (the ';' packing at src/strategies/sticky/model.py:553). Also fails any src line longer than 200 characters.

changes.name: test_no_dead_anchors
changes.notes: AST-scans src/**/*.py and fails on any statement matching `_ = <expr>`. Introduced in P0 with an explicit allowlist seeded from the current 975 occurrences; the allowlist shrinks to empty by P7 and is then deleted with the parameter.

changes.name: project_root
changes.notes: Walks up from Path(__file__) until a directory containing pyproject.toml is found; raises ConfigError if none. lru_cached.

changes.name: config_path
changes.notes: project_root() / 'configs' / f'{name}.yaml'. Rejects names containing '/' or '..'.

changes.name: load_config
changes.notes: lru_cached yaml.safe_load of config_path(name). FAIL-CLOSED: raises ConfigError if the file is missing, unreadable, or does not parse to a mapping. Never returns a default.

changes.name: config_value
changes.signature: def config_value(name: str, *keys: str, default: object | None = None, required: bool = False) -> Any
changes.notes: Nested lookup. If the key path is absent: raises ConfigError when required=True, else returns default. A present-but-wrong-typed value ALWAYS raises ConfigError — a malformed config must never be silently indistinguishable from an absent key (this is the specific defect in today's overlays.py loaders).

changes.name: clear_config_caches
changes.notes: Clears project_root and load_config caches; wired into src/core/settings.py:clear_settings_caches and into the test conftest.

changes.name: overlay_param
changes.signature: def overlay_param(strategy_id: str, key: str, *, default: float | str | None = None, aliases: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> Any
changes.notes: THE single replacement for load_p22_lock_level, load_p24_lock_level, load_p24_trail, load_p24_mom_col, load_p25_arm, load_p25_lock_remaining, load_p26_arm, load_p26_lock_remaining. wiring.invocation_expression: sum(1 for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.stmt))

requirements: R1 (fail-closed config, replaces silent defaulting): load_config raises ConfigError when the file is missing, unreadable, or does not parse to a mapping. config_value raises ConfigError when a key is PRESENT but the wrong type. Only an ABSENT key may fall back to `default`, and only when required=False. The current `except Exception: return float(default)` pattern in all 8 overlays.py loaders is removed, not preserved.

R2 (CWD independence): after P1 no module under src/ may contain a relative Path("configs/...") or open("configs/..."). Every config read resolves through project_root(), which anchors on pyproject.toml. Enforced by a grep assertion in test_config_single_source.

R3 (single parse): configs/strategies.yaml is parsed at most once per process. load_config is lru_cached; the 8 duplicate parses in overlays.py and the 4 duplicate sponsor_brands/taxonomy parses in alpha/baselines.py collapse to one each.

R4 (D1 — no legacy ids at runtime): after P2, `rg -n '\"P[0-9]{2}[AB]?\"' src/` returns zero hits. resolve_strategy_id('P27') raises ValueError. LEGACY_ALIASES exists in exactly one place — tools/migrate_runs_registry_ids.py — and that file is not importable from src/.

R5 (identity invariant): for every semantic id S in src/strategies/ids.py, STRATEGIES[S]().name == S. No exceptions, no re-assignment carve-outs. This is a behaviour change for the 9 strategies that currently keep legacy names; it is accepted only if R14 shows zero metric drift.

R6 (ARCH-1 / INV-24 preserved): the split must not blur layer boundaries. Alpha factories under src/strategies/factories/ select theme/index keys only; leverage-vehicle selection stays in src/portfolio/exposure.py; overlay/regime policy stays in src/tournament/. No new module may import across those boundaries in the wrong direction.
R7 (INV-10 preserved): decision-at-close(t) / fill-at-open(t+1) mechanics are untouched. build_backtest_context only assembles inputs; it must not compute or reorder any signal.

R8 (statement budget, replaces line budget): every module under src/ passes the AST statement budget (default 400) with NO per-path waiver and NO pending_split list. Modules are split by cohesion — a split that produces a package of tiny fragments with circular imports is a failure, not a pass.

R9 (no packed lines): no two ast.stmt nodes in src/ may share a lineno, and no src line may exceed 200 characters. This directly reverses the 492-character semicolon-packed line at src/strategies/sticky/model.py:553.
R10 (no dead anchors): after P7, zero `_ = <expr>` statements remain in src/. Wiring evidence is an import plus a call, verified by AST — never a string literal.

R11 (typing): the [[tool.mypy.overrides]] ignore_errors block for module src.cli is deleted and `uv run mypy .` passes strict on the new CLI package. Registry values are typed StrategyProtocol, not object.

R12 (one name per concept): no public def in src/ takes a parameter named model_key, strategy_key, as_of, or cal. The canonical spellings are strategy_id, decision_date, calendar. CLI flag names are unchanged.

R13 (one source per number): the championship thresholds and the 36-session horizon are read from configs/gates.yaml and configs/tournament.yaml. No numeric literal 0.30/0.40/0.50/0.60/36 encoding those quantities remains in src/tournament/.

R14 (behavioural equivalence gate — the primary safety requirement): before P2, capture a golden artifact by running `uv run mt-etf backtest --model sticky.mom60_raw --start 2018-01-02 --end 2026-08-27 --leverage-scenario aggressive --eval-mode adoption` (pre-P2 this is `--model P27`). Store metrics + the 36-session exceedance curve under scratch/refactor_golden/. After EVERY phase, re-run and require bitwise-equal equity curve and exceedance values (P(R36>0.30/0.40/0.50/0.60) and P(R36<-0.25)). Any drift halts the phase and is reverted — a refactor that moves a distribution metric is a bug, not a refactor.

R15 (no scope-shrinking on the golden run — .agents/rules/performance.md §0): the golden run uses the full 2018-01-02..2026-08-27 range every time. No shortened range, no sampled subset, no iteration cap. A watchdog may be set at 5-10x the first measured wall-clock duration purely to detect a hang; tripping it is reported as an infrastructure bug, never treated as 'close enough'.

R16 (test-failure ledger): the 20 pre-existing failures are recorded before P0. After each phase the failure set must be a subset of {baseline failures} minus {P-code tests deleted by D1}. A NEW failing test id at any phase halts that phase.

R17 (artifact migration is one-shot and reversible): tools/migrate_runs_registry_ids.py writes docs/results/runs_registry.jsonl.bak before rewriting, and supports --dry-run. It is run exactly once, in P2, and its output counts are recorded in the ADR.

R18 (phase atomicity): each phase P0..P7 is a separate commit that leaves the tree green against R8/R11/R16. Phases are not interleaved; P0 must land before any anchor is deleted, and P1 before any file that reads config is moved.
non_goals: Changing any strategy's mathematics, parameters, or ranking logic. This is behaviour-preserving by construction (R14).
Fixing the 20 pre-existing test failures, except the P-code identity tests that decision D1 necessarily deletes or rewrites.
Changing CLI flag names or the subcommand surface. Only --model's accepted VALUES change (semantic ids only, per D1) and its help text.
Raising or lowering any adoption gate, threshold, or exposure cap. Values move from literals into config; they do not change.
Introducing new runtime dependencies, a plugin system, or an abstraction layer for hypothetical future strategies. The registry dict is sufficient.
Re-tuning performance. The golden run's wall-clock is recorded for information; making it faster is out of scope and must not motivate any structural choice.

scenarios.expected_behavior: A module whose only mention of the symbol is inside a dead `_ = '<literal>'` statement FAILS wiring verification; a module that really imports and calls it PASSES. This is the defect that let 975 anchors accumulate.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
import ast
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def _load_verify_wiring():
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("tools/agent_skills").resolve()))
    import lean_check

    return lean_check.verify_wiring


def test_verify_wiring_rejects_string_literal_only(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # Given: a module that only mentions the symbol inside a dead anchor
    fake = tmp_path / "anchor_only.py"
    fake.write_text(
        "from __future__ import annotations\n"
        "_ = \"resolve_strategy_id(model_key)\"\n"
        "_ = 'if model_key == \"P23\":'\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    verify_wiring = _load_verify_wiring()

    # When
    ok, reason = verify_wiring(fake, "resolve_strategy_id", "resolve_strategy_id(model_key)")

    # Then
    assert ok is False
    assert reason

    # Given: a module that genuinely imports and calls it
    real = tmp_path / "real_call.py"
    real.write_text(
        "from src.strategies.registry import resolve_strategy_id\n"
        "\n"
        "def run(model_key: str) -> str:\n"
        "    return resolve_strategy_id(model_key)\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    ok2, _reason2 = verify_wiring(real, "resolve_strategy_id", "resolve_strategy_id(model_key)")
    assert ok2 is True
    assert isinstance(ast.parse(real.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), ast.Module)

    monkeypatch.setattr(cfg, "load_config", lambda name: {"portfolio": {"family_peak_lock": {"lock_level": "not-a-number"}}})

design_rationale.alternatives_considered: (1) Keep LEGACY_ALIASES as a thin compatibility shim and only reorganise files. REJECTED by user decision D1, and independently weak: the dual naming is the root cause of the 4303-line if-chain, the 9 inconsistent .name carve-outs, and the 238 P-code literals in _impl.py. Leaving the alias layer means the next feature cycle re-grows the chain. (2) Repeat the R3 pattern — create per-command wrapper modules that delegate back into a monolith. REJECTED: that is exactly what produced today's src/cli/commands/*.py (5-15 line files whose body is `from src.cli._impl import cmd_X as _impl`). It moves the import graph without moving a single line of logic, and the ADR recorded it as done. Real decomposition must move the bodies. (3) Introduce a plugin/entry-point registry so strategies self-register. REJECTED as speculative abstraction (.claude/CLAUDE.md §1): the strategy set is closed and known at build time; a dict in registry.py is deterministic, greppable, and statically typed, and a plugin loader would make static analysis worse for an AI reader — the opposite of this task's stated goal. (4) Fix the 975 dead anchors without touching lean_check.py. REJECTED by user decision D3 and by mechanism: the anchors exist because the checker greps for text. Deleting them while the substring check stands would make lean_check report broken wiring on correct code, and the next agent would re-add them. The tool must measure imports and calls before the workaround can be removed. (5) Keep the raw-line budget test and simply raise the caps. REJECTED: the cap is already being gamed — src/strategies/sticky/model.py:553 packs 8 statements into one 492-character line specifically to stay under 700 lines, and test_global_src_line_budget waives the 12 files that actually violate it. Raising the number would formalise the fiction. Counting AST statements and banning packed lines makes the metric un-gameable in the direction that matters. (6) Do the refactor as one atomic change. REJECTED: 53k lines with 20 pre-existing failures and no behavioural test harness gives no way to attribute a regression. The phased order (tooling -> config -> ids -> factories -> CLI -> splits -> naming -> purge) is chosen so that each phase's precondition is established by the previous one.
design_rationale.chosen_reason: The three stated goals — AI working efficiency, extensibility, maintainability — all reduce to one measurable property: a symbol's meaning must be derivable from static reading, without re-deriving a mapping. Today it is not, in four distinct ways. Identity is dual (semantic id + P-code, with 9 strategies deliberately inconsistent), so an agent must load registry.py to know what a name refers to. Configuration is multi-sourced (8 duplicate YAML parses of one file, CWD-relative so they silently default, thresholds re-hardcoded next to the config that defines them), so an agent cannot tell which value wins. Behaviour is not locatable (one 4303-line function reached through wrapper modules that delegate back into it), so an agent must read 6607 lines to change one family. And the verification tooling rewards text over behaviour, so the codebase has accumulated 975 statements that exist only to be grepped. The phase order attacks the enabling condition of each: P0 makes the checks measure behaviour, which is what makes deleting the anchors safe; P1 gives config one fail-closed source, which is what makes moving files safe; P2 collapses identity to one namespace, which is what turns the 34-way if-chain into a 6-entry family dict; P3-P5 then split by cohesion rather than by line count; P6-P7 close the loop with executable naming and anchor rules so the drift cannot silently re-form. Every phase is gated on R14, a full-range golden backtest of the champion strategy with bitwise-equal exceedance metrics, because the only acceptable outcome of a refactor on financial code is that the distribution does not move.
failure_modes: FM1 — silent metric drift from the .name unification. R5 forces obj.name == semantic id for all 38 strategies, removing 9 deliberate carve-outs. If any downstream code keys behaviour (not just labelling) off obj.name — e.g. an overlay lookup, an artifact path, or a config section resolved by name — the champion's exceedance curve moves without any test failing, because no current test asserts on the distribution. GUARD: R14's golden-run comparison runs after every phase and compares P(R36>0.30/0.40/0.50/0.60) and P(R36<-0.25) bitwise; drift halts and reverts the phase. Before P2, grep every `\.name` read in src/ and classify each as label-only or behavioural.

FM2 — config fail-closed converts silent defaults into hard crashes. The 8 overlays loaders currently swallow every exception and return a default, and they read a CWD-relative path, so in any non-root CWD they have ALWAYS returned the default. Making them fail-closed may surface the fact that some strategy has been running on defaults rather than on configs/strategies.yaml, which would itself change results. GUARD: P1 lands BEFORE P2 and is followed immediately by the R14 golden run. If the golden metrics move at P1, that is not a refactor bug — it is a pre-existing correctness defect being exposed, and it must be reported and adjudicated (ADR) before any further phase, never papered over by restoring the silent default.

FM3 — splitting a module by size instead of cohesion produces circular imports. src/tournament/champion_eval.py, distribution_core.py and objective_impl.py are mutually entangled and today lean on `from X import *` shims (distribution.py, objective.py, adoption_reports.py) to hide it. A naive split will deadlock at import time or force lazy in-function imports, which is a strictly worse outcome for static analysis than the monolith. GUARD: R8 states explicitly that a split producing fragment packages with circular imports is a failure; test_layer_boundaries_preserved enforces the directional import rules; each split is validated by `uv run python -c 'import src.tournament.champion'` before the phase is committed.

FM4 — the P-code test rewrite hides a real regression. 65 test files reference legacy codes and 12 of them are already failing at baseline. Rewriting them to semantic ids gives an easy path to 'fix' a failure by weakening the assertion. GUARD: R16 keeps a written ledger of the 20 baseline failures. Every P-code test is rewritten by MECHANICAL id substitution only — assertions, tolerances and fixtures are preserved verbatim. A test that still fails after substitution stays failing and stays in the ledger; it is not adjusted.

FM5 — build_backtest_context flattens a per-strategy setup difference. The 4303-line cmd_backtest repeats panel/calendar/universe construction inside each P-code branch, and those repetitions are not necessarily identical — one branch may filter the universe differently or use a different eval control model (`_make_eval_control_model`). Hoisting them into one context builder can silently normalise a genuine difference. GUARD: before writing build_backtest_context, diff all 34 branch-local setup blocks and record any that differ in the ADR; a differing block becomes an explicit BacktestContext field, never an averaged-away default. R14 then verifies the champion path end to end.

FM6 — the new architecture tests become the next thing that gets gamed. test_module_statement_budget, test_no_dead_anchors and test_naming_consistency are all mechanical gates, and this codebase has already demonstrated that mechanical gates get satisfied rather than met (semicolon packing, dead anchors, delegating wrappers). GUARD: each of these tests asserts on a property that has no cheap workaround — AST statement counts survive line packing, `_ = expr` detection survives renaming, and the layer-boundary test is directional. Where a genuine exception arises it is resolved by an ADR entry, not by adding a waiver list; R8 explicitly forbids reintroducing pending_split.

performance_budget.expected_data_scale: Golden-run verification only. ~2125 XKRX sessions (2018-01-02..2026-08-27) x the 10-sponsor deployment universe (~40-120 eligible ETFs per session), replayed once per phase for 8 phases plus a pre-P2 baseline = 9 full runs total. No new data volume is introduced; this refactor moves code, not computation.
performance_budget.storage_format: Parquet/PyArrow for the silver and feature panels (unchanged); golden metrics serialised as JSON under scratch/refactor_golden/<phase>.json
performance_budget.dtype_precision: Unchanged. float64 is retained everywhere it is used today — the golden-run comparison is bitwise on exceedance values, so any dtype change would register as drift and is therefore out of scope by construction.
performance_budget.chunking_strategy: Unchanged. src/backtest/session_cache.py continues to own session-level caching; the P5 split of engine.py must preserve the existing cache boundaries rather than re-chunk.
performance_budget.note: Per .agents/rules/performance.md §0 this budget carries no timeout_s and no iteration cap. The golden run executes the full date range every time. A hang watchdog may be set at 5-10x the first measured wall-clock; a trip is reported as an infrastructure bug, never accepted as a partial result.

verification_plan: BASELINE (before P0): record `uv run pytest -q --timeout=900 2>&1 | tail -40` into scratch/refactor_golden/baseline_tests.txt — expected 20 FAILED; record `uv run ruff check .` (2 errors) and `uv run mypy .` (Success, 315 files, src.cli excluded).

BASELINE (before P2): `uv run mt-etf backtest --model P27 --start 2018-01-02 --end 2026-08-27 --leverage-scenario aggressive --eval-mode adoption` -> save metrics + exceedance curve to scratch/refactor_golden/baseline_metrics.json. Full range, no truncation (R15).

PER PHASE (P0..P7), all four must pass before the phase is committed: (a) `uv run ruff check .`; (b) `uv run mypy .`; (c) `uv run pytest -q --timeout=900` with the failure set a subset of the baseline ledger (R16); (d) the golden backtest re-run compared bitwise against baseline_metrics.json (R14).
P2 specific: `rg -n '\"P[0-9]{2}[ABV]?\"' src/ | wc -l` must be 0; `uv run python tools/migrate_runs_registry_ids.py --dry-run` reviewed before the live run.
P4 specific: `uv run mt-etf --help` and `uv run mt-etf backtest --help` diffed against the pre-refactor output — only the --model help text may differ.
P7 specific: `uv run python tools/agent_skills/gen_code_map.py` to regenerate docs/code_map.json; re-run lean_check on this contract with the AST-based wiring check.

FINAL: `uv run pytest -q` failure set == baseline ledger minus the deleted P-code identity tests; `uv run mypy .` passes with no src.cli override; src/ contains 0 dead anchors, 0 legacy codes, 0 CWD-relative config reads, and 0 modules over 400 statements.
acceptance: A1: The champion's 36-session exceedance curve and ruin probability are bitwise identical to the pre-refactor baseline at every phase. This is the primary acceptance criterion; nothing else compensates for its failure.
A2: `resolve_strategy_id` accepts semantic ids only; zero legacy P/B/M literals remain in src/; every STRATEGIES[S]().name == S.

A3: src/cli/_impl.py, src/cli/dispatch.py, src/cli/dispatch/, src/alpha/baselines.py, src/alpha/sticky.py, src/strategies/baselines/core.py, src/tournament/distribution.py, src/tournament/objective.py and src/tournament/adoption_reports.py no longer exist; cmd_backtest is <= 80 statements and dispatches through a family table of real functions.
A4: `uv run mypy .` passes strict with the src.cli ignore_errors override removed from pyproject.toml.
A5: Every module under src/ is under 400 AST statements with no waiver list and no per-path cap; no line holds two statements; no line exceeds 200 characters.

A6: configs/ is the single source for the championship thresholds and the 36-session horizon; all config access goes through src/core/config.py, is CWD-independent, cached, and fail-closed on malformed values.
A7: Zero `_ = <expr>` statements in src/; lean_check verifies wiring by AST import+call evidence, and a string-literal-only mention fails verification.
A8: No public signature in src/ uses model_key, strategy_key, as_of or cal; the canonical names are strategy_id, decision_date, calendar. CLI flags are unchanged.
A9: docs/architecture (02, 07, 09) and docs/code_map.json reflect the new package topology; an ADR records the phase results, the migration counts from R17, and any FM2/FM5 discrepancy found.
scaffolding_note: The following directories were created empty at spec time so the pre-impl path gate can resolve targets: src/strategies/factories/, src/cli/commands/backtest/families/, src/cli/commands/decide/, src/tournament/champion/, src/tournament/distribution/, src/tournament/objective/, src/reporting/tail_forensics/, tests/unit/tools/. They deliberately contain NO __init__.py — verified empirically that a bare directory does not shadow the sibling module file (src.tournament.distribution still resolves to distribution.py), so the current import graph is unaffected. implement creates each __init__.py in its own phase and deletes the sibling .py module (distribution.py, objective.py, adoption_reports.py, backtest.py) in the SAME commit as the package that replaces it. Git does not track empty directories, so a fresh checkout will not have them; implement must mkdir as needed.
